2105-5895-7175-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5895-7175-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5895-7175-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2363-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Hangarback Walker is in your graveyard.
2363-5006-8170.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Hangarback Walker. It enters as dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat.

3727-8182.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Karakas can tap to produce {10} or more.
3727-8182.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {10}
Cast Emrakul by paying {10} plus commander tax if applicable.
Emrakul triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Resolve Emrakul. Then, activate Karakas's second ability by tapping it, returning Emrakul from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-1129-4644.easyPrerequisites: Harabaz Druid and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-1129-4644.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
512-1129-4644.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Harabaz Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1129-4644.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Harabaz Druid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

529-3197-7730-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-1385-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-1385-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-2374-2841-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2374-2841-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3585-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3585-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1379-5414-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-5414-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Troubled Healer.

2946-3967-4871-6026.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3967-4871-6026.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1563-2433-4321-5086.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token and a Food token due to Peregrin Took.
Rosie Cotton triggers twice, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus and another +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Activate the Food by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1563-2433-4321-5086.notes: You can sacrifice the Triskelavite tokens to their own abilities to deal infinite damage.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7727.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1274-3330-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3330-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2292-4742-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

1069-4460-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-4460-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

372-997-4681.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Abdel Adrian.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1238-2351-5467-6798-7040.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2034-4013-5004-6643-6967.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

413-862-2173-5220.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Crimson Kobolds enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

5220-6538-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

2084-6913.description: Activate Chameleon by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Chameleon into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1084-3108-5400.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Synth Infiltrator.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Synth Infiltrator by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2921-3560-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Biotransference, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

659-955-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-955-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

341-5078-5741.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1339-4365-5349.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four tokens.
1339-4365-5349.description:
Activate Izoni by sacrificing four tokens, causing you to surveil 2, draw two cards, and gain 2 life.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with haste.
Repeat.

481-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have no instants and/or sorceries in your graveyard.
481-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's first ability triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

814-3094-4050-4853.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three Soldiers.
Myrel does not have summoning sickness.
814-3094-4050-4853.description:
Declare Myrel as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Myrel's ability.
Resolve the copy of Myrel's ability, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {2}.
When the Soldiers die, Dross Scorpion triggers twice, untapping Lithoform Engine and any other artifact you control.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2438-4231-5267.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' first ability triggers, creating a Clue, a Food, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

553-2927.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain seven life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Plunge into Darkness by paying {1}{B} and seven life, looking at the top seven cards of your library, putting Approach of the Second Sun into your hand and exiling the rest.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

1303-2232-2452.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary, nonartifact Zombie card in hand.
1303-2232-2452.description:
Cast a nonlegendary, nonartifact Zombie by paying {0}.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Necroduality.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of the Zombie.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the nontoken Zombie to your hand.
Repeat.
